desc: Yoshi's colour from the second screen's Wardrobe (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW, TTYD_WARDROBE_ROW): right on his row goes to the game as a tap, which sets it as the Wardrobe's row does (the pouch, the field Yoshi's model) at the point its own Start menu could open; before, the second screen's frame set it and the copy back undid it
